shipped_rows.title_o: Prepulses Reduce the Pain of Cutaneous Electrical Shocks

blind_target.evidence_quote: The present experiment investigated the generality of this effect by presenting weak acoustic stimuli simultaneously with, or 80 or 1000ms prior to, painful electric shocks.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Failure to replicate previous findings of decreased pain by weak prepulses was most likely due to the sensory modality of the prepulse stimuli.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly reports failure to replicate the previous pain reduction. The original citation and number of original papers are unavailable in the abstract; this is an unresolved target placeholder, not a verified count of originals.
